about_the_game:
This DLC is not compatible with accounts created outside of Steam.

Feel the speed and power of the first Allied jet fighter! This meteor is ready to break into your Hangar and tear apart enemies with four rapid-firing 20 mm autocannons!
The Gloster Meteor F. I has outstanding speed and optimal altitude performance for its tier. If you need to intercept bombers, the Meteor is the best choice for this task. Its jet engine will allow you to soar into the heat of the fight, helping your allies over remote sectors! Additional equipment will make this aircraft even stronger.

DLC Content:

  • Gloster Meteor F. I, a British Tier VII fighter: The first jet fighter of the Royal Air Force is ready for service! Fight on the legendary aircraft, surprise your opponents by appearing in the most unexpected places, and use its effective weapons and high speed to dominate in the skies of World of Warplanes.
  • Hangar slot for your new warbird.
  • Fully trained pilot with 5 skill points.
  • x25 Incendiary Ammunition: maximizes chances of causing a fire and increases chances of inflicting critical damage.
  • Engine Boost Mixture Injection System (Period II): allows you to make your boost even more effective.
  • Reinforced Airframe (Period II): gives additional hit points to your aircraft.
  • 2,000 gold: significantly expand your in-game opportunities.
